summary.text: Garret Nelson represents District 29 in the Alaska House of Representatives; the Legislature's member page lists his oath as taken on December 30, 2025.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, he comes from an Idaho ranching family and earned a B.S. in animal science production from the University of Idaho.
The biography says the family had made Sutton home by 2016 and that he has served on the Sutton Community Council, recently as its chair.
